map.从教学质量、课程设计、学习进步、场馆环境、服务态度五个维度评估舞蹈培训质量，每项: Evaluate dance training quality across five dimensions - teaching quality, course design, student progress, venue environment and service attitude - each scored 1-5, then compute a weighted composite score and generate improvement suggestions.

map.综合评分 = Σ（各维度得分 × 维度权重），各维度按 5 分制打分，权重之和为: Composite score = Σ (dimension score × dimension weight), each dimension scored on a 5-point scale and weights sum to 100%; a composite score of 4.5 or above is excellent, 3.5 to 4.4 is good, 2.5 to 3.4 is average, and below 2.5 is fail; dimensions scoring 1 to 2 are flagged as weak areas that need teaching improvement measures. Track teaching quality by scoring teaching effect, progress and satisfaction separately.
map.综合评分 = 各项得分 × 权重之和（教学质量与学习进步权重更高）: Composite score = weighted sum of item scores × weights (teaching quality and student progress carry higher weights)
map.单项得分 ≤2 分的项目将列入重点改进项: Items scoring 2 or below are listed as key improvement targets

map.期末教学复盘：五个维度分别打分，算加权综合分与评级，定位最弱维度便于针对性补强。: End-of-term teaching review: score the five dimensions separately, compute the weighted composite and grade, and locate the weakest dimension for targeted improvement.
map.学员进步跟踪：按入班、阶段、结课三次评分画出进步曲线，量化教学成效。: Student progress tracking: plot a progress curve from enrollment, midterm and final assessments to quantify teaching effectiveness.
map.机构横向对比：多班级同维度均值对比，辅助排课、师资与场馆资源调整。: Cross-institution comparison: compare dimension averages across classes to guide scheduling, staffing and venue resource decisions.
map.教学4.5/课程4.0/进步4.8/环境4.2/服务4.0（等权），加权综合 4: Teaching 4.5 / Course 4.0 / Progress 4.8 / Environment 4.2 / Service 4.0 (equal weights) gives a weighted composite of 4.3 → grade A; the shortcoming is course design, so schedule an extra choreography breakdown class next week.
map.权重怎么定？: How do I set the weights?
map.可按机构侧重点设维度权重，默认等权；权重文件仅留本地浏览器。: Set dimension weights according to institutional priorities; equal weights are the default. The weight file stays in the local browser only.
map.评分要上传服务器吗？: Do ratings need to be uploaded to a server?
map.不需要。全部评分在本地处理，不上传，保护学员与机构数据隐私。: No. All ratings are processed locally and never uploaded, protecting the privacy of student and institution data.
map.结果能直接用于正式考核吗？: Can the results be used directly for formal assessment?
map.仅作内部质量跟踪参考，不替代机构的正式考核与人事制度。: Treat them as internal quality tracking references only; they do not replace the institution formal assessment or HR system.
